result.title: Rekonstruktion U-Bhf. „Spittelmarkt“ Nebenräume - Ausgang Spittelmarkt, TP: Sanitäre Installation
result.main_content: Floor plan (Grundriss) of the auxiliary rooms and the exit to Spittelmarkt at the reconstructed U-Bahn station, documenting the sanitary installation. The layout is shown between track 1 and track 2 and includes the routing of cold water, gas (natural gas) and dirty-water piping, an insulated line, a drain pipe NW 60 with cover and a washing table (510 mm) with mirror, shelf and hook rail. Notes require coordination with the electrical trade before installation, specify that the gas line is to be laid under the platform as welded construction, and reference the existing electrical installation and fouling water in the track area to be allowed to seep away.
